site_name: East Acton Arcade93 Old Oak Common LaneActonW3 7DJ
description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment in (S96a) to planning permission 220178FUL dated 07.08.2024 for 'Demolition of existing building to enable construction of multi-storey hotel (Use Class C1) including flexible space within basement for hotel (Use Class C1) or snooker hall (Use Class E(d)) use; and ancillary shared cafe/restaurant/workspaces; associated landscape works and public realm improvements.' Amendment seeks reduction of 45.63 sq.m (GEA) at both basement level -1 and -2; removal of one light well situated toward the north-eastern corner, loss of a window within room 14 as a result of the removal of the lightwell; extension of external seating area at ground floor level, as a result of the removal of the lightwell; internal reconfiguration of the proposed snooker hall to accommodate the reduction in floorspace; and a minor reduction in hotel ancillary back of house floorspace at level 1 to take into account the reduced floorspace
